findings.body: `_MCP_PROSE_REF = re.compile(r'(?<![\w/])/mcp\s+([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)\s+([A-Za-z0-9_*-]+)')` uses `(?<![\w/])` whereas `_SCRIPT_REF` in the same file uses `(?<![\w/.-])`. Consequently, relative paths like `./mcp foo bar` or hyphenated paths like `foo-/mcp bar baz` match `_MCP_PROSE_REF` (because `.` and `-` are not in `[\w/]`). In addition, un-backticked English prose such as `/mcp command to ...` matches as `server='command', tool='to'`, and markdown emphasis around un-backticked references such as `*mcp__conport__get_context*` or `*/mcp conport get_context*` includes the closing `*` in the tool token because `*` is inside `[A-Za-z0-9_*-]+`. | COORDINATOR ADJUDICATION: see proof/MACRO-DMX-CMD-REPAIR-002/review_bundle/AUDIT_ADJUDICATION.md
findings.title: _MCP_PROSE_REF lookbehind omits '.' and '-' and _MCP_TOOL consumes trailing markdown '*' emphasis

findings.body: `_MCP_REF = re.compile(r'mcp__' + _MCP_SERVER + r'__' + _MCP_TOOL)` has no leading negative lookbehind (e.g. `(?<![A-Za-z0-9_*-])`), so a malformed token with a prefix like `xmcp__conport__get_context` or `bad-mcp__conport__get_context` matches the valid suffix `mcp__conport__get_context` and false-passes. Conversely, `mcp___conport__get_context` (three underscores after `mcp`) fails `[A-Za-z0-9-]+` at the start of `_MCP_SERVER` and is silently ignored rather than reported. | COORDINATOR ADJUDICATION: see proof/MACRO-DMX-CMD-REPAIR-002/review_bundle/AUDIT_ADJUDICATION.md
findings.title: _MCP_REF lacks a leading boundary and silently skips triple-underscore after 'mcp'

findings.body: `test_should_accept_prose_reference_when_tool_is_captured` only asserts that `check_mcp_tool_refs` and `check_mcp_servers` return `[]`, without asserting that `_mcp_refs(tmp_path)` actually extracted `('cmd.md:1', 'conport', 'get_context')`. Both assertions and `test_should_ignore_slash_mcp_when_embedded_in_a_path` (`assert list(_mcp_refs(tmp_path)) == []`) would pass against the pre-change code where `/mcp` was not scanned at all. Also, `test_should_ignore_slash_mcp_when_embedded_in_a_path` only tests word characters before `/mcp` (`docs/mcp`, `a/mcp`) and does not test `//mcp` or `./mcp`. | COORDINATOR ADJUDICATION: see proof/MACRO-DMX-CMD-REPAIR-002/review_bundle/AUDIT_ADJUDICATION.md
findings.title: Two new W08 prose tests would pass even if _MCP_PROSE_REF were a no-op

findings.body: As documented in `docs/02-how-to/mcp-integration-guide.md` and the packet facts, `pal-stdio`, `gpt-researcher`, and `MCP_DOCKER` are recorded as `unreachable` with zero tools in `mcp_tool_surfaces.json`, so individual tool names under `mcp__pal-stdio__*` (such as `apilookup`, `thinkdeep`, `debug`, `codereview`, `analyze`) cannot yet be verified against a live/seed tool list, and bare prose tool names without `mcp__` or `/mcp` prefixes remain unscanned pending `MCPINT-FND-DRIFTGATE-003`. | COORDINATOR ADJUDICATION: see proof/MACRO-DMX-CMD-REPAIR-002/review_bundle/AUDIT_ADJUDICATION.md
findings.title: Residual drift-gate gaps remain for unreachable stdio server tool lists and bare prose tool mentions
